fields.System.Title: OUT-408 — Capture serial numbers on pick
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker, I want to scan each serial number as I pick it, so that we know exactly
which unit went to which customer.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a serial-tracked product, then the number of serials scanned must equal the
  • picked quantity.
  • - Given a serial not currently in that location, then the scan is rejected.
  • - Given a serial already shipped, then the scan is rejected.
  • - Given confirmation, then each serial is linked to the order line and travels through
  • packing and shipping.
  • - Given a returned serial, then it can be matched back to the order it shipped on.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | serial records, pick_task_line |
| Risks | Serial tracking complicating every downstream flow ([doc 07 §10](../../../docs/07-phased-delivery-plan.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
